subject: Evaluation plan: confirm owners & timeline
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@finora.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation plan: confirm owners & timeline

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan that lays out the evaluation milestones, suggested owners, and a proposed two-week test window for inference throughput and latency checks.

Quick highlights (from the attachment):
- Week 1: small-scale PoC (latency + basic functionality) — Owner: Finora (suggested Jake Turner)
- Week 2: load/throughput run + cost breakdown — Owner: Redwood (Monica)
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 200ms for 512 tokens; stability over a 1 hour sustained load.

Can you confirm the owners and whether the target dates look reasonable for your team? Once you confirm, I’ll lock the schedule and send calendar invites for the kickoff + technical onboarding.

Attachment: Finora_Redwood_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)

Thanks —
Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Olivia —

Following up on the MAP I sent Monday. Wanted to check whether you had a chance to review and assign internal owners. I know timelines can shift — if now isn't the right week, totally understood — just want to keep the plan updated so we can reserve the right test window on our side.

If it helps, here are two quick options we can take:
1) Lock the original plan (kickoff next Tue, 11/9) — Finora owner: Jake Turner; Redwood owner: Monica
2) Push kickoff by one week (kickoff 11/16) — same owner assignments but later dates

Could you reply with which option works for you or propose an alternative? If you prefer a 15-minute sync, happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Camila

Can you let us know which works for you and whether you’d like Redwood to run a short pre-kickoff checklist with your infra team (30 minutes) to validate networking, API keys, and data segmentation? Monica will lead the technical onboarding on our side.

- Network reachability & firewall rules (who’s the owner at Finora?)
- Test dataset and tokenization sanity check
- Access/roles for monitoring dashboard

If 11/9 works, I’ll send calendar invites for kickoff + checklist. If not, we’ll lock 11/16 and I’ll update the MAP dates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
